en: There you are! Lots of passengers lately, and lots of lost property. Nobody's claimed this one, so it's yours.
Better a Trainer uses it than it sits in my drawer. I'm sure it's happier too!
Oh ho! A Trainer, by the look of you. I'm a Depot Agent on the Battle Subway, in Nimbasa City.
Passengers leave all sorts behind on the trains. This one's gone unclaimed for ages. Would you take it off my hands?
Come back another day. There's always more lost property!
Nothing new in the lost property today. Come back tomorrow, and try the Battle Subway in the meantime!
